summary: Regression test after code-quality refactor (useCallback deps, TOOLTIP_STYLE/BAR_CURSOR/TOAST_OPTIONS extraction, entry.category Cell key, console.warn in autoCategorize catch). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests PASS covering categories, categorize, expenses CRUD (create/list/filter/search/update/recategorize/delete/persistence), budgets (create/upsert/list/delete), dashboard summary shape+values, CSV export. Frontend: all pages render, INR ₹ + en-IN formatting confirmed, no infinite re-render loops (Dashboard=2 summary calls after 2s idle, Expenses=1 call after idle), auto-categorize Uber airport → Transport works and hint text 'Auto-categorized as Transport' shown, budget create for Food & Dining ₹5000 rendered card, Insights page renders all 3 stat cards + bar chart + category ranking, edit dialog prefills correctly, ZERO console errors, ZERO duplicate-key warnings (confirms entry.category Cell key fix).
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, not a bug): backend datetime.now(timezone.utc) shows year 2026-07 as the current month in this environment; all tests correctly use TODAY based on server clock so expenses appear in current-month summary.
Minor: In Insights.jsx the `mounted` cleanup flag is set but the fetch never awaits or checks abort — acceptable, no leak in practice because getSummary resolves quickly.
Minor: server.py places CORS middleware AFTER include_router — this still works in FastAPI but conventionally middleware should be added before including routers.
Minor: /api/expenses supports search regex without escaping user input; safe against Mongo but could match unintended chars (e.g. `.*`). Non-critical for this app.
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 TEST_-prefixed expenses + 1 Food & Dining budget + 1 Utilities budget during the run; expense fixtures cleaned up via session teardown fixture; budgets from UI flow (Food & Dining ₹5000) remain but are idempotent upserts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `cd /app && pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. All 19 tests pass in <2s (parallel workers). Frontend refactor concerns from this iteration (no re-render loops, no duplicate-key warnings, filters+debounce, budget create re-fetches summary) are all verified. Auto-categorize hint text is 'Auto-categorized as <Category>' — use it as a positive signal in future runs. Server clock is set to July 2026 in this env; use datetime.now for date fields to keep expenses in current month.
rca of the issue: No issues found; refactor is clean regression.
